findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_places" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List every place dossier (per-jurisdiction reading) the observatory publishes. Optionally filter by state. Returns city, state, slug, signal strength, signal di…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "trace_connection" is 3284 chars, far longer than this server's median (613). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Trace how two named things in the planning record connect, and report how specific that connection is. Give `from` and `to` for the shortest route between them;…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_places, list_corridors, list_patterns, describe_pattern · Private data: meeting_index, list_meetings, get_track_record, semantic_search, trace_connection · Public sink: list_watch_items, describe_watch, submit_agent_feedback, trace_connection · Destructive: trace_connection.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_places, list_corridors, list_patterns, describe_pattern · Private data: meeting_index, list_meetings, get_track_record, semantic_search, trace_connection · Public sink: list_watch_items, describe_watch, submit_agent_feedback, trace_connection · Destructive: trace_connection

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
